title: AudioMoth Species Diversity by Site
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batdetector:pass
| stats dc(species_guess) as species_count count as bat_passes by site_name
| sort 0 - species_count
description: Ranks sitess by bat species diversity.
value: Species diversity by site helps separate busy but repetitive activity from genuinely rich acoustic locations.
implementation: Send bat species diversity events to `index=personal` and keep `site_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of bat species diversity by sites.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds which sitess stand out most for bat species diversity.
